plan.title: Tag cards truncate long tags - measure the vocabulary before redesigning

narratives.Overview: Tag words extend beyond the card and appear to fit only about seven characters. The card design is attractive but does not survive long tags.
narratives.Problem: TagGalleryView.swift:234 sets .lineLimit(1) on the tag label inside an HStack carrying a leading icon and a trailing scope label. In a fixed-width grid cell the label has no room to grow and no permission to wrap.
narratives.Action: MEASURE FIRST. The right treatment depends on how long tags actually get and how many are affected. Options in increasing order of change: lineLimit(2) plus minimumScaleFactor; move the icon above the text so the label gets full cell width; widen the cell / reduce columns; redesign for a text-first hierarchy.
narratives.Constraint: The tag vocabulary is short today but is expected to grow substantially if tags are imported from an external provider. Design for the projected distribution, not only the current one.
narratives.Risk: Designing for a 40-character tag that does not exist is wasted work; designing for 7 when 30 is coming is a second redesign.
narratives.Test: T8 - the chosen treatment is asserted at the longest length in the measured vocabulary.
